states.meaning: Ordinary public mobility works without AI, account, network or model.
AI may aggregate grouped demand and explain a conflict without taking public right-of-way or human authority.
An outage, weather event or safety conflict freezes the digital layer and returns people to human or public transport service.
After withdrawal, the useful public asset remains independently maintainable and the change is archived.

prototypes.ordinary_service: rail_or_bus_arrival, walking and staffed loading guidance
prototypes.ai_boost: aggregate enterprise arrival windows and flag curb conflicts
prototypes.blackout_action: freeze shuttle or curb booking and dispatch public transport or a named marshal
prototypes.bequest_asset: paper curb-window register, protected-route sign and maintenance card
prototypes.responsible_role: enterprise mobility role plus transport/accessibility reviewer

prototypes.ordinary_service: walk-in, telephone, paper and continuous accessible route for daily needs
prototypes.ai_boost: group service windows and explain an optional detour without retaining continuous traces
prototypes.blackout_action: disable recommendation and keep the staffed route, public transport and complaint desk open
prototypes.bequest_asset: tactile/static route card, human service directory and dated correction log
prototypes.responsible_role: community liaison plus accessibility and privacy reviewer

prototypes.ordinary_service: rail timetable, public crossing, staffed wayfinding and a protected return path
prototypes.ai_boost: compare grouped transfer windows and propose reversible feeder separation
prototypes.blackout_action: remove feeder demand and preserve the public route when headway, crossing or curb evidence is missing
prototypes.bequest_asset: static interchange map, event-day curb protocol and public withdrawal notice
prototypes.responsible_role: rail/bus operations role plus independent safety reviewer

phase_sequence.action: inventory ordinary routes, assets, owners, consent boundaries and dated denominators
compare one ordinary route with one optional grouped-demand explanation
phase_sequence.gate: ordinary route remains available to every group

phase_sequence.action: run offline shadow and negative fixtures without field authorization
phase_sequence.gate: all hard failures return to HOLD

phase_sequence.action: rehearse BLACKOUT, handoff, public notice and reservation freeze
phase_sequence.gate: named receiver and dated restoration record

phase_sequence.action: audit BEQUEST assets, maintenance burden, complaints and group differences
phase_sequence.gate: expand, repair or withdraw only after independent review

boundary: The contract makes ordinary service, bounded AI, withdrawal and retained public assets reviewable. It does not prove a route, staffing, capacity, authorization, user outcome, safety result or operating performance.
